sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，很高兴你能回来收听又一期节目，当然，我们要一如既往地剖析二十岁的人生心理学。

sentences.en: If you have been a long-time listener of the podcast, you will know that there is one TED Talk I reference probably three to four times a year, and it's titled
sentences.zh: 如果你一直是这个播客的忠实听众，你就会知道有一个TED演讲我一年大概会引用三到四次，它的名字是

sentences.en: Your Elusive Creative Genius by Elizabeth Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·吉尔伯特的《你那难以捉摸的创作天才》。

sentences.en: This TED Talk entirely changed how I thought about success, how I thought about inspiration, failure, and on a deeper level, what it really meant to be human.
sentences.zh: 这个TED演讲彻底改变了我对成功的看法、对灵感的看法、对失败的看法，并在更深层次上改变了我对身为人类真正含义的理解。

sentences.en: When Elizabeth, or Liz, as she's more commonly known as, released her book, Big Magic, it once again changed my life, and it is firmly one of my favorite,
sentences.zh: 当伊丽莎白（或者大家更常叫她利兹）出版她的书《大魔法》时，它再次改变了我的生活，并且它稳居我最喜爱、

sentences.en: probably most read books of all time.
sentences.zh: 可能也是我读过最多遍的书籍之一。

sentences.en: When I was first really getting listeners with the podcast back in 2021, someone asked me who my dream guest would be, and I said, Liz.
sentences.zh: 早在2021年，当我刚开始认真为播客积累听众时，有人问我谁是我梦寐以求的嘉宾，我说，利兹。

sentences.en: Because of that book, because of how incredible her mind is, because of all the books that she has since written, and all the wisdom that she really has to share,
sentences.zh: 因为那本书，因为她那不可思议的思维，因为她自那以后写的所有书，以及她真正想要分享的所有智慧，

sentences.en: and it was a huge dream back in 2021, one that I really never thought was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这在2021年是一个巨大的梦想，一个我真的从未想过会实现的梦想。

sentences.en: But now, in 2025,
sentences.zh: 但现在，在2025年，

sentences.en: it's somehow finally come true, and I couldn't be more excited to have Liz on the podcast to discuss how to find our purpose, how to keep making and creating things,
sentences.zh: 它不知怎么地终于成真了，我无比激动地邀请到利兹来到播客，讨论如何找到我们的人生目标，如何不断进行创作，

sentences.en: dealing with failure, managing success, and the best advice she has for people in her 20s.
sentences.zh: 如何应对失败、管理成功，以及她给二十岁人群的最好建议。

sentences.en: This episode is so very special to me and will forever have a place in my heart, but I also just hope you all enjoy it and you learn something.
sentences.zh: 这一期节目对我都非常特别，并将永远在我心中占据一席之地，但我也希望你们所有人都能喜欢它并有所收获。

sentences.en: All right, without further ado, I want to welcome on Liz Gilbert to the show, to the psychology of your 20s.
sentences.zh: 好了，废话不多说，我想欢迎利兹·吉尔伯特来到节目中，来到《二十岁心理学》。

sentences.en: Liz, can you briefly introduce yourself and tell us about your work?
sentences.zh: 利兹，你能简单介绍一下自己并跟我们聊聊你的工作吗？

sentences.en: Yes, first of all,
sentences.zh: 好的，首先，

sentences.en: I'm so happy to be here and honored to be here talking to you.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来到这里，也很荣幸能在这里跟你交谈。

sentences.en: My name is Liz Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 我叫利兹·吉尔伯特。

sentences.en: I'm known, I guess, professionally as Elizabeth Gilbert, but that feels weird to introduce myself that way.
sentences.zh: 我想我在职业上被称为伊丽莎白·吉尔伯特，但用这种方式介绍自己感觉怪怪的。

sentences.en: I'm the author of Eat, Pray, Love, and Big Magic, and The Signature of All Things, and City of Girls, and a bunch of other books.
sentences.zh: 我是《一、祈祷、爱》、《大魔法》、《万物之签名》、《女孩之城》以及其他许多书的作者。

sentences.en: And I also have,
sentences.zh: 而且我还有，

sentences.en: I'm a fiction and nonfiction author, but I also spend a lot of time teaching.
sentences.zh: 我是一名虚构和非虚构类作家，但我同时也花很多时间进行教学。

sentences.en: And I don't teach writing because I don't know how, but I teach a sort of general spirit of creativity, what I call creative living, a way of living,
sentences.zh: 我教的不是写作，因为我不会，但我教的是一种普遍的创造力精神，我称之为创造性生活，一种生活方式，

sentences.en: where I simply define it this way, where you make your decisions based on your curiosity rather than your fear.
sentences.zh: 我简单地将其定义为：你根据自己的好奇心而不是恐惧来做决定。

sentences.en: And that ends up becoming a very creative life.
sentences.zh: 这最终会成就一种非常具有创造力的生活。

sentences.en: So I'm sort of known also for that as being a teacher of creativity and kind of spirituality.
sentences.zh: 所以我某种程度上也因此而闻名，作为一个创造力和某种精神层面的导师。

sentences.en: That would be an amazing job title to have.
sentences.zh: 那会是一个令人惊叹的职位头衔。

sentences.en: A teacher of creativity and spirituality.
sentences.zh: 创造力和精神导师。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm like, all right.
sentences.zh: 我在想，好吧。

sentences.en: So new career path unlocked.
sentences.zh: 新职业道路已解锁。

sentences.en: That sounds amazing.
sentences.zh: 听起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Let's change the vision board up.
sentences.zh: 让我们换个愿景板吧。

sentences.en: I think I said this in my introduction, but most people know you for Big Magic, not for Big Magic, for Eat, Pray, Love, probably.
sentences.zh: 我想我在自我介绍时说过，但大多数人认识你可能是因为《一、祈祷、爱》，而不是《大魔法》。

sentences.en: I think I was a little bit too young to really understand Eat, Pray, Love, but I did really understand Big Magic.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时太年轻了，还不太理解《一、祈祷、爱》，但我确实真正理解了《大魔法》。

sentences.en: And it was just such a beautiful book that I continue to reference to this day.
sentences.zh: 这是一本如此美丽的书，以至于我直到今天仍在引用它。

sentences.en: Do you remember,
sentences.zh: 你还记得吗，

sentences.en: you know, in the interest of understanding purpose, do you remember when you kind of realized like, oh, I'm going to be a writer?
sentences.zh: 为了理解人生目标，你还记得你是什么时候突然意识到，哦，我要成为一名作家？

sentences.en: I'm going to be this creative, curious person.
sentences.zh: 我要成为这样一个充满创造力和好奇心的人。

sentences.en: This is my calling.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的使命。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I'm really glad you used the word calling
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你用了使命这个词，

sentences.en: because I would love to just launch in with some thoughts that I have about the word purpose and how much anxiety that word causes.
sentences.zh: 因为我很乐意直接切入一些我对“目标”这个词的想法，以及这个词带给我们多少焦虑。

sentences.en: Can we just start with that?
sentences.zh: 我们能从这个话题开始吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Because it's something, obviously, a lot of people listening to this are like in their 20s and the amount of them that email me being like, I don't know what my purpose is.
sentences.zh: 因为很显然，听这个节目的很多人正处于20多岁，他们给我发邮件说“我不知道我的人生目标是什么”的数量非常庞大。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Okay, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, please.
sentences.zh: 好的，请吧。

sentences.en: Let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 我们深入聊聊。

sentences.en: My honeys, my sweeties, you have been so terribly misinformed.
sentences.zh: 我的宝贝们，我的甜心们，你们被严重误导了。

sentences.en: This is my opinion.
sentences.zh: 这是我的看法。

sentences.en: Everything I'm saying is my own opinion.
sentences.zh: 我所说的一切都只是我个人的观点。

sentences.en: Take what you like and leave the rest, but I will throw out into the void and it will land on whoever it needs to land on that there's this thing called purpose anxiety.
sentences.zh: 取你所需，其余的随风去吧，但我会把这些话说进虚空，它会降落在任何需要它的人身上，那就是存在着一种所谓的“目标焦虑”。

sentences.en: And I scarcely know anybody who doesn't suffer from it.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，几乎没有人不受其困扰。

sentences.en: And I know some of the people who appear to be at the very, very, very top of a purpose-driven life.
sentences.zh: 而且我认识一些似乎正处于目标驱动型生活最顶端的人。

sentences.en: And have apparently achieved it.
sentences.zh: 并且显然已经实现了这一点。

sentences.en: And they also still suffer from purpose anxiety.
sentences.zh: 他们其实也依然饱受目标焦虑的折磨。

sentences.en: And the reason that everybody suffers from purpose anxiety is because everyone in Western contemporary culture has been told this same theology.
sentences.zh: 每个人之所以都会遭受目标焦虑，是因为西方当代文化中的每个人都被灌输了同一种神学观念。

sentences.en: And it really is a theology.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种神学。

sentences.en: And you've been told variants of this from the time you were born.
sentences.zh: 你们从小到大都被灌输了这种观念的各种变体。

sentences.en: And you've heard it in every graduation and commencement speech and in every self-help book.
sentences.zh: 你在每一次毕业典礼演讲和每一本自助书中都听过它。

sentences.en: And no one has ever questioned whether it even makes sense or whether it is even true.
sentences.zh: 而且从来没有人质疑过它究竟有没有道理，或者它是否真实。

sentences.en: But here's the theology.
sentences.zh: 但神学的内容是这样的。

sentences.en: Everyone is born with a unique purpose
sentences.zh: 每个人出生时都带有一个独特的目标，

sentences.en: that is completely their own and totally unrelated to anybody else.
sentences.zh: 这个目标完全是他们自己的，与其他人毫无关系。

sentences.en: It's one thing that only you can do.
sentences.zh: 这是只有你能做的一件事。

sentences.en: Nobody but you can do it.
sentences.zh: 除了你，没有人能做到。

sentences.en: So already that creates anxiety in me because there's 8 billion people on the planet.
sentences.zh: 所以这就已经让我感到焦虑了，因为星球上有80亿人口。

sentences.en: And so what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: I'm supposed to find something in me that no one else can do?
sentences.zh: 我是要在自己身上找到一件别人都做不到的事吗？

sentences.en: Like the maths don't even add up on that, right?
sentences.zh: 从数学角度来说这根本说不通，对吧？

sentences.en: And you should know it from the time that you're born.
sentences.zh: 而且你从出生起就应该知道这一点。

sentences.en: And you should always know what it is.
sentences.zh: 并且你应该一直清楚它是什么。

sentences.en: It should be extremely clear what it is.
sentences.zh: 它到底是什么应该极其清晰。

sentences.en: And then your job is to devote your entire life to that one thing.
sentences.zh: 然后你的工作就是把你的整个一生都奉献给那唯一的一件事。

sentences.en: And if you miss the boat and it's too late and you haven't gotten on that, you should be extremely anxious and ashamed of yourself that you don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了时机，已经太迟了，没能走上那条路，你应该为自己不知道那是什么而感到极度焦虑和羞耻。

sentences.en: I mean, this is what people are taught.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是人们被教导的。

sentences.en: And then you must become the master of that thing.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须成为那件事的大师。

sentences.en: You must devote an enormous amount of time, attention and money to mastering whatever that thing is, that unique spark that nobody else has.
sentences.zh: 你必须投入大量的时间、注意力和金钱去精通无论那是什么事情，那个别人都没有的独特火花。

sentences.en: And then you must monetize it.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须将其商业化。

sentences.en: Because if you make your money doing anything other than the thing that is your unique spark and purpose, then you are a failure.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你靠做除那件属于你独特火花和目标之外的任何事情来赚钱，那你就是个失败者。

sentences.en: And it's not enough that you must monetize it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅将其商业化还不够。

sentences.en: You must become the best at it.
sentences.zh: 你必须成为其中的佼佼者。

sentences.en: And you must also create opportunity for others.
sentences.zh: 你还必须为他人创造机会。

sentences.en: And you must then change the world through your purpose.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须通过你的目标来改变世界。

sentences.en: This is what literally everybody is told.
sentences.zh: 这就是字面意义上每个人都被灌输的观念。

sentences.en: And no wonder everybody is full of anxiety about it.
sentences.zh: 难怪所有人都为此充满焦虑。

sentences.en: And I mean, if we can just break it down for a minute, first of all, it comes from a place of enormous hubris and arrogance to portend, to believe,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我们花一点时间来剖析它，首先，它源于一种极其自负和傲慢的心态，去妄想、去相信，

sentences.en: like to think that you can know what you are here for when we don't even know what this is, this planet, consciousness, this experience.
sentences.zh: 就好像认为当我们在甚至不知道这究竟是什么——这个星球、意识、这种体验——的时候，你就能知道自己是为了什么而来到这里。

sentences.en: Like we don't even know.
sentences.zh: 就像我们甚至都不知道一样。

sentences.en: We literally have no idea what's going on and like why your soul was dropped into your particular body and born into your body.
sentences.zh: 我们简直毫无头绪到底发生了什么，以及为什么你的灵魂会被投放到你特定的身体里并出生在你的身体里。

sentences.en: Like we can't know.
sentences.zh: 就像我们不可能知道一样。

sentences.en: And anybody who pretends that they know, you should be very suspicious of them.
sentences.zh: 对于任何假装自己知道的人，你都应该对他们保持高度怀疑。

sentences.en: Um, so there's an enormous arrogance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一种极大的傲慢。

sentences.en: Also, can you hear how self-centered it is?
sentences.zh: 另外，你听得出这有多自我中心吗？

sentences.en: Purpose theology comes from Western men.
sentences.zh: 目标神学源自西方男性。

sentences.en: And so it's all about, I have to be incredibly important.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都关乎，我必须变得极其重要。

sentences.en: I actually have to be the most important and I have to change the world in my own image.
sentences.zh: 我实际上必须是最重要的，我必须按照我自己的形象去改变世界。
